title: Frattini Geometry of Non-Generating Complexes: Symmetry, Homology and Betti Numbers
summary: For a finite group \(G\), let \(N(G)\) be the simplicial complex of subsets that do not generate \(G\). We separate a general Frattini-topological reduction from the structure special to finite \(p\)-groups. For every finite noncyclic group, the non-cone Frattini core is homotopy equivalent to the order complex of the proper part of the subgroup lattice of \(G/Φ(G)\). For a finite \(p\)-group this quotient is an elementary abelian vector space, and the core becomes the non-spanning complex of a uniform parallel extension of \(\mathrm{PG}(r-1,p)\), where \(r=d(G)\) and \(q=|Φ(G)|\).
